title.narrative: UNESCO participation in the preparatory meeting of WWF and IHP GCC activities

description.narrative:
This work plan is dedicated to the following priority activities: 1- The 2nd Stakeholders Consultation Meeting -11th World Water Forum: The Second Stakeholders Consultation Meeting of the 11th World Water Forum co-hosted by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the World Water Council, will be held on 8th–9th of April 2026, Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
2- The 16th GULF WATER CONFERENCE: Doha Office organized in Oman in 2025 the first meeting of IHP GCC and plans to host the second meeting on the sidelines of the 16th Gulf Water conference which calls for a major transformation and transitioning of the water sector in the GCC countries. It advocates for an integrated holistic approach in the management of the water sector, planned strategic investments, and the adoption of cutting-edge AI technologies.
